name: Metro de Bogotá
body: nosniff, GA4, a declared language, and a working sitemap. But Strict-Transport-Security sets max-age=1000, about 17 minutes, so browsers forget the https-only rule almost as soon as they learn it.
lesson: Set HSTS max-age to at least one year (31536000) once https works everywhere.
summary: www.metrodebogota.gov.co scores 79 out of 100 (C). 0 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 15 pages name another URL as canonical.

fix.title: 15 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: / → /, /empresa-metro-bogota → /empresa-metro-bogota, /empresa-metro-bogota/valores-corporativos → /empresa-metro-bogota/valores-corporativos, /empresa-metro-bogota/historia → /empresa-metro-bogota/historia and 11 more. Search engines will usually index the…
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 15 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 15 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 9 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /empresa-metro-bogota/mapa-procesos, /linea-1, /linea-2 and 5 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 15 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 15 pages analyzed.
